headline: Children's author Amirul Islam dies at 62
summary: The renowned writer, who authored over 200 books for children, passed away in a Dhaka hospital after battling kidney complications.
details: Prominent children's author Amirul Islam passed away at 1:07 AM on Thursday, September 10, while receiving treatment at a hospital in Dhaka.
He was 62 years old and had been suffering from severe kidney complications for a long time, requiring regular dialysis.
He was admitted to the hospital on August 13 and was placed on life support around 3 AM last Sunday as his condition deteriorated.
Born on April 7, 1964, in Lalbagh, Old Dhaka, he spent decades contributing to Bengali children's literature through countless stories, rhymes, poems, and plays.
With over 200 published books, he created a distinct style by vividly capturing the psychology, joy, and imagination of children in simple and lively language.
In recognition of his outstanding contributions to children's literature, he was awarded the prestigious Bangla Academy Literary Award in 2006.
He also received numerous other important honors and awards from both home and abroad throughout his literary career.
caption:
A giant of Bengali children's literature is gone. Author Amirul Islam, who wrote over 200 books, has passed away.

Prominent children's author Amirul Islam passed away at 1:07 AM on Thursday, September 10, while receiving treatment at a hospital in Dhaka.

He was 62 years old and had been suffering from severe kidney complications for a long time, requiring regular dialysis.

He was admitted to the hospital on August 13 and was placed on life support around 3 AM last Sunday as his condition deteriorated.

Born on April 7, 1964, in Lalbagh, Old Dhaka, he spent decades contributing to Bengali children's literature through countless stories, rhymes, poems, and plays.

With over 200 published books, he created a distinct style by vividly capturing the psychology, joy, and imagination of children in simple and lively language.

In recognition of his outstanding contributions to children's literature, he was awarded the prestigious Bangla Academy Literary Award in 2006.

He also received numerous other important honors and awards from both home and abroad throughout his literary career.

headline: 47 Bangladeshis return through Benapole after 2 years in Indian prison
summary: The group of repatriated citizens has returned home after spending two years in incarceration in India.
details: 47 Bangladeshi citizens have returned to Bangladesh through the Benapole land port.
The individuals had been imprisoned in India for the past two years.
They were repatriated to their home country following the necessary legal and diplomatic processes.
The group arrived at the border crossing and were handed over to the Bangladeshi authorities.
